system.description:
Like a ventriloquist without limits, the Daughter of Cacophony casts her voice to any spot within her line of sight. She does not merely make her voice seem to come from there — her speech or song truly generates from thin air, independent of her own throat, letting her hold two conversations at once.

You may use The Missing Voice at will, whenever you desire, at no cost; all Melpominee effects retest with the Performance Ability. The thrown voice functions independently of your normal speech, so you can carry on two conversations simultaneously. However, if you use The Missing Voice while performing other actions, your divided concentration imposes a two-Trait penalty on the resolution of your challenges.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
